governmentSubsidy.title: Government Subsidy Eligibility Calculator
governmentSubsidy.description: Review 2026 criteria and missing information for 12 Korean support programs.
governmentSubsidy.policyChecked: Policy sources checked: October 4, 2026 · Official program guidance

screening.title: Screening is separate from official approval
screening.description: Monthly income is not assessed income. Asset conversion, deductions, household composition and support obligations are not assessed automatically. Conditional benefit amounts require known basic-livelihood assessed income.
screening.noTotal: Cash, medical assistance, education vouchers and savings matches have different payment schedules and overlap rules, so they are not added into a total.

reasons.incomeOver: Entered assessed income exceeds this benefit threshold.
reasons.livelihoodConditional: Income criterion met. Amount assumes other requirements and assessed income are confirmed.
reasons.medicalConditional: Income criterion met. Medical support obligations need separate review.
reasons.housingConditional: Conditional calculation includes the region, contractual rent and household contribution.
reasons.housingNonRental: Owners need a repair assessment. Repair benefits are not converted into monthly cash.
reasons.regionRequired: Select a region to apply its rent limit.
reasons.noActualRent: Rental benefit is not calculated when deposit conversion and monthly rent are both zero.
reasons.studentRequired: Income criterion met, but school attendance and school level are unknown.
reasons.childrenRequired: No qualifying child under 18 at the tax-credit reference date is selected.
reasons.taxAssetsOver: Entered assets are at least KRW 240 million. Check the tax-credit valuation date.
reasons.taxDetailsRequired: Household type, annual couple income, earned income and reference-date assets need review.
reasons.pensionDetailsRequired: Elderly-household assessed income, spouse status and occupational pensions require separate assessment.
reasons.elderRequired: No applicant or household member aged 65 or older is selected.
reasons.youthBirthYear: The 2026 rent program uses birth years 1991–2007. Check the birth year.
reasons.youthRentRequired: The national youth program requires actual monthly rent. Check housing conditions.
reasons.youthRentClosed: 2026 new applications have closed. Review prior payments and original-household requirements in the detailed calculator.
reasons.singleParentDetailsRequired: Program-specific assessed income, child age, school attendance and supplements need review.
reasons.savingsAge: The 2026 enrollment age is 15–39 at application.
reasons.savingsDetailsRequired: Personal earned income is separate from household assessed income. 2026 enrollment has closed.
reasons.emergencyDetailsRequired: Crisis grounds, regional assets, financial assets and duration require individual review.
reasons.disabilityDetailsRequired: A household member with a disability does not establish severe-disability pension eligibility.

livelihood.name: Basic Livelihood Benefit
livelihood.requirements: Assessed income at or below 32% of median; other household and support-obligation exceptions apply.
livelihood.benefit: Conditional amount is the threshold minus assessed income, assuming all other requirements are met.
livelihood.check: Confirm asset conversion, deductions, debts and the benefit household.
livelihood.apply: Check the official guide for application timing, procedures and required documents.

medical.name: Medical Benefit
medical.requirements: Assessed income at or below 40% of median; medical support-obligation rules also apply.
medical.benefit: Medical cost assistance rather than fixed monthly cash. Costs vary by eligibility type and treatment.
medical.check: Check support obligations, benefit type and treatment-specific copayments.
medical.apply: Check the official guide for application timing, procedures and required documents.

housing.name: Housing Benefit
housing.requirements: Assessed income at or below 48% of median; lease and occupancy requirements apply.
housing.benefit: 2026 regional rent limits; deposit converted at 4% annually. Deduct 30% of assessed income above the livelihood threshold.
housing.check: Owner repairs require an inspection. Check zero rent, rent above five times the limit and minimum-payment rules.
housing.apply: Check the official guide for application timing, procedures and required documents.

education.name: Education Benefit
education.requirements: Students at covered schools with assessed income at or below 50% of median. A minor-child flag does not prove enrollment.
education.benefit: 2026 annual activity allowance: elementary KRW 502,000; middle 699,000; high 860,000. No amount is assumed without the school level.
education.check: Check enrollment, school level, voucher application and additional school-fee support.
education.apply: Check the official guide for application timing, procedures and required documents.

childCredit.name: Child Tax Credit
childCredit.requirements: 2026 regular applications use 2025 couple annual income below KRW 70 million, reference-date assets below KRW 240 million and qualifying children.
childCredit.benefit: Annual KRW 500,000–1 million per child. Assessed credit is halved for assets of at least KRW 170 million; income bands and child tax deductions affect it.
childCredit.check: Current monthly income is not multiplied into past annual income. Verify earned income, reference-date assets and dependents with NTS.
childCredit.apply: Check the official guide for application timing, procedures and required documents.

eitc.name: Earned Income Tax Credit
eitc.requirements: 2026 regular applications use 2025 income below KRW 22/32/44 million for single/sole-earner/dual-earner households; assets below KRW 240 million.
eitc.benefit: Annual maximum KRW 1.65/2.85/3.3 million. Assets of at least KRW 170 million halve the credit. No amount is assumed without the household type and eligible earnings.
eitc.check: Household size does not identify tax-credit type. Verify earned income, household type, income year and asset reference date.
eitc.apply: Check the official guide for application timing, procedures and required documents.

basicPension.name: Basic Pension
basicPension.requirements: Age 65+. 2026 elderly-household assessed-income limits: KRW 2.47 million single / 3.952 million couple per month; not 70% of median income.
basicPension.benefit: 2026 base pension up to KRW 349,700 per month; national-pension linkage, couple and income-related reductions may apply.
basicPension.check: Check elderly-household composition, spouse and occupational pensions, and pension-specific assessed income. Household size does not identify a couple.
basicPension.apply: Check the official guide for application timing, procedures and required documents.

youthRent.name: National Youth Rent Support
youthRent.requirements: 2026 applicants use birth years 1991–2007; youth/original-household income and assets, housing ownership and rent require review.
youthRent.benefit: Actual rent up to KRW 200,000 monthly, with up to 24 lifetime payments less prior payments. Household income is not divided into personal income.
youthRent.check: 2026 new applications closed May 29. Distinguish the Seoul city program and review remaining payments in the detailed calculator.
youthRent.apply: Check the official guide for application timing, procedures and required documents.

singleParent.name: Single-parent Child Support
singleParent.requirements: 2026 program-specific assessed income at or below 65% of median; children under 18, with a high-school exception below 22.
singleParent.benefit: Base child support KRW 230,000 per child per month. Supplements and adolescent-parent rules differ.
singleParent.check: Basic-livelihood assessed income alone does not finalize this program. Check child age, enrollment and parent category.
singleParent.apply: Check the official guide for application timing, procedures and required documents.

youthSavings.name: Youth Tomorrow Savings Account
youthSavings.requirements: 2026 new enrollment: age 15–39, personal earned/business income at least KRW 100,000 monthly and household assessed income at or below 50% of median.
youthSavings.benefit: Government deposits KRW 300,000 monthly when the member saves at least KRW 100,000. Deposits are restricted savings with retention, education and maturity requirements.
youthSavings.check: 2026 enrollment closed May 20. Household income is not divided into personal earnings. Existing members must check their enrollment-year rules.
youthSavings.apply: Check the official guide for application timing, procedures and required documents.

emergency.name: Emergency Welfare Support
emergency.requirements: Crisis grounds, income criteria including 75% of median, and separate regional/financial asset rules apply.
emergency.benefit: Amount depends on support type and household size. Duration extensions require assessment; six months is not assumed.
emergency.check: Contact the community center or welfare hotline 129 to assess the crisis, urgency and support type.
emergency.apply: Check the official guide for application timing, procedures and required documents.

disabilityPension.name: Disability Pension
disabilityPension.requirements: Covered adults with severe disabilities; a disability in the household does not establish severity, assessed income or spouse requirements.
disabilityPension.benefit: 2026 combined base and supplementary benefit up to KRW 439,700 monthly, depending on age, recipient type and reductions.
disabilityPension.check: Check applicant age, disability severity, program-specific assessed income and spouse status, including transition at age 65.
disabilityPension.apply: Check the official guide for application timing, procedures and required documents.

whatIs.title: What does this tool check?
whatIs.description: It compares some entered conditions with 2026 criteria for 12 programs. It does not finalize full eligibility or actual payments.

howToUse.title: How to use
items: Enter household size and monthly household income.
Select assessed income only if you know the amount for basic-livelihood benefits.
For rental housing support, choose the region and enter contractual deposit and rent.
Review support criteria and read each card’s missing conditions.
Confirm valuation dates, household composition and overlap rules with the official agency.

tips.title: Things to verify
items: Assessed income includes assessed earnings and income converted from assets, rather than salary alone.
Tax credits use the relevant income year and asset valuation date; current monthly income is not annualized.
Housing support varies by regional rent limits and household contribution.
Savings matches, vouchers and medical support are not monthly cash and should not be simply summed.

items.a: Monthly KRW 2,564,238 for one person and KRW 6,494,738 for four. Programs apply different percentages and income assessments.

items.q: Why is there no total payment?
items.a: Cash, tax credits, vouchers, medical support and restricted deposits have different schedules and overlap rules, so a reliable total cannot be calculated.
